clue.text: Fundamental to computerese

definitions.meaning: elementary, at the root of things
computer jargon: an early beginners' programming language of this name

explanation.walkthrough: Two definitions joined by 'to': the everyday adjective and the name of a programming language.
explanation.definitionFit: Elementary and fundamental are synonyms; the programming language counts as a piece of computer jargon.

clue.text: Not an upright, but an enthusiastic report on child's health

definitions.meaning: a horizontal piano, in contrast to an upright one

definitions.text: an enthusiastic report on child's health
definitions.meaning: a happy verdict that the infant is fine

explanation.walkthrough: The second definition splits the answer into 'baby' and 'grand', British for terrific, so the child is doing well.
explanation.definitionFit: A small horizontal piano is the opposite of an upright, and a thriving infant could be called excellent.

clue.text: Speak after warning to be silent in camera

indicators.note: speaking comes after the hush, so it follows in the answer

parts.note: sh is a call for quiet
to utter is to speak

explanation.surface: A judge telling a court to hush because a case will be heard privately.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In camera' looks like the legal phrase for in private, but here it means a part found inside a camera.
explanation.definitionFit: The shutter is the mechanism inside a camera that opens to admit light.

clue.text: It ends movement of cash on delivery article

parts.note: a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: Something finishes the shipment of a parcel paid for when it arrives.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Movement' looks like transport of goods, but it is a section of a musical work.
explanation.definitionFit: A coda is the closing passage of a piece or section of music.

clue.text: Unreasonable description of how Animal Farm finished up

definitions.meaning: stubbornly refusing to see sense

definitions.text: description of how Animal Farm finished up
definitions.meaning: in Orwell's novel the farm ends with the swine in charge, the farm topped by pigs

explanation.walkthrough: In George Orwell's Animal Farm the pigs take over and end up running the farm, so it finished up headed by pigs.
explanation.definitionFit: Obstinate, stubborn behaviour is unreasonable; the second sense reads the word as farm led by swine.

clue.text: Interrupt advice on how to board a packed tube train

definitions.meaning: to manage to speak in a conversation

definitions.text: advice on how to board a packed tube train
definitions.meaning: squeeze in sideways, edge first

explanation.walkthrough: A tube train is a London Underground train; the advice is to slip into the crowded carriage sideways.
explanation.definitionFit: To force a remark into a conversation is to interject, and to squeeze sideways into a crowd is the literal sense.

clue.text: Take one from seven and it will be

definitions.text: Take one from seven and it will be

indicators.note: one letter is removed from the start of the following word

explanation.walkthrough: Removing one letter, S, from SEVEN leaves the answer, and taking one from seven arithmetically leaves six, which is itself an even number.
explanation.definitionFit: Seven minus one is six, a number divisible by two.

clue.text: He opens up when guests arrive

definitions.text: He opens up when guests arrive

parts.words: He opens up when guests arrive
parts.note: a hotel attendant who unlocks or holds the entrance for visitors

explanation.definitionFit: A hotel or club attendant who holds the entrance open for visitors.

clue.text: He gives the fellow an alternative

parts.note: a don is a fellow of a university college
or introduces an alternative

explanation.surface: A man offering someone a choice.
explanation.definitionFit: A benefactor who gives money, blood or organs is a giver.

clue.text: Spring-heeled Jack was a cad

definitions.meaning: a legendary Victorian figure said to leap enormous heights, so one who bounds
an old word for a dishonourable man

explanation.walkthrough: Spring-heeled Jack was a creature of English folklore said to escape by huge leaps, so a literal leaper; 'bounder' is also old British slang for a cad.
explanation.definitionFit: A leaper is one who bounds; a cad is an ungentlemanly rogue in old-fashioned slang.

clue.text: His Ring reach'd war structured proportions

definitions.text: His Ring reach'd war structured proportions

indicators.note: the letters are built into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: The composer's operatic cycle reached the scale of a war.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Structured' rearranges RING, REACHD and WAR into the name of the composer of the four-opera Ring cycle, which is famously epic in scale.
explanation.definitionFit: The German composer wrote Der Ring des Nibelungen, a vast cycle of four operas.

clue.text: Restrict fine feathers to neckwear

indicators.note: the feathers are attached to the end of the neckwear, so they follow it

parts.note: a tie is worn round the neck
down is the soft fine plumage of birds

explanation.surface: A dandy fixing fine plumes onto a cravat.
explanation.definitionFit: To fasten something so it cannot move is to restrict or constrain it.

clue.text: Barbarian type obtained most dangerous sort of bomb

parts.note: got means obtained
the H-bomb, the hydrogen bomb, the deadliest kind

explanation.surface: A savage warrior getting hold of a terrible weapon.
explanation.definitionFit: The Goths were a Germanic people the Romans regarded as barbarians.

clue.text: Sulphur cannot be in short supply

parts.note: S is the chemical symbol for sulphur
can't is a contraction of cannot

explanation.surface: A chemist complaining that sulphur cannot be found because stocks are low.
explanation.definitionFit: Something scant is meagre, barely enough, scarce.

clue.text: Moslem leader seen in the mirror

indicators.note: the letters can be spotted inside the words that follow, as if glimpsed in them

explanation.surface: A Muslim ruler catching sight of himself in a looking glass.
explanation.definitionFit: An emir is a Muslim ruler or commander, a title of Arabic origin.

clue.text: Property in the form of a collection

parts.note: as means in the role or form of
a set is a collection

explanation.surface: Real estate held as part of a portfolio.
explanation.definitionFit: An asset is a valuable possession, an item of property.

clue.text: Rough grass bed

definitions.meaning: ... grass, a coarse weed
a sofa or bed to lie on

explanation.walkthrough: Couch grass is a coarse, creeping grass weed.
explanation.definitionFit: Couch grass is a tough weedy grass, and a sofa serves as a bed.

clue.text: What sort of clues are given to help passengers reach the other platform?

definitions.text: What sort of clues are given to help passengers reach the other platform?

parts.words: What sort of clues are given to help passengers reach the other platform?
parts.note: reads as station directions: to get to the far platform you go over the bridge and then descend; it also names the two kinds of crossword clue

explanation.surface: A railway passenger asking for directions to another platform.
explanation.definitionFit: Crossword clues come in two directions, horizontal and vertical, and the same pair of words is the route over a footbridge.

clue.text: Irritated by surgical thread on the hem

parts.note: a seton is a thread passed under the skin to keep a wound draining
a hem is the edge of a garment

explanation.surface: A patient annoyed by stitches along the fringe of a garment.
explanation.walkthrough: A seton is a surgeon's thread drawn through tissue to keep a wound open; 'set on edge' means made jittery.
explanation.definitionFit: Teeth or nerves set on edge are jarred, made tense and annoyed.

clue.text: Drug peddler chased by traffic police?

parts.note: speed is slang for amphetamine
a merchant is a trader, one who sells

explanation.surface: A dealer in narcotics being pursued by motorway patrols.
explanation.definitionFit: A habitual fast driver is someone motorway patrols would pursue, the question mark flagging the playful definition.

clue.text: Thus ceremonies lead to a whole series of arguments

parts.note: so means thus
rites are ceremonies

explanation.surface: Rituals sparking a run of quarrels.
explanation.definitionFit: In logic a sorites is a chain of syllogisms, each conclusion feeding the next premise.

clue.text: Admitted even though none had paid up

definitions.meaning: let in, permitted

definitions.text: even though none had paid up
definitions.meaning: every person still had a debt

explanation.walkthrough: The second definition splits the answer into 'all owed': everyone was still in debt.
explanation.definitionFit: Being let in is being permitted entry; split in two, the word says everybody was in debt.

clue.text: Revolutionary act

parts.note: one full rotation is a revolving movement, and a music-hall performance by one entertainer is also called by this word

explanation.definitionFit: A rotation is a revolution, and a variety performer's spot on the bill is likewise called a turn.

clue.text: Steadily drank up the whole store

indicators.note: in a down clue the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: a depot is a storehouse

explanation.surface: A drinker emptying the entire stock.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The whole' is linking padding: the entire store is the depot.
explanation.definitionFit: To tope is to drink alcohol habitually and heavily.

clue.text: Land acquired by father in the first month

indicators.note: the father is placed inside the month

parts.note: Jan is short for January
pa is an informal word for father

explanation.surface: Property bought by Dad at the start of the year.
explanation.definitionFit: Japan is a country, a land in East Asia.

clue.text: Family is able to provide liberal accommodation

indicators.note: the outer word accommodates, houses, the letter for liberal

parts.note: can means is able

explanation.surface: A family that can offer generous lodging.
explanation.definitionFit: A clan is an extended family group, especially in Scotland.

clue.text: Network of Middle East silence

parts.note: sh is a call for silence

explanation.surface: A broadcaster's Middle East service going quiet.
explanation.definitionFit: A mesh is a net, an interlaced network of strands.

clue.text: It is just behind the front seats and above the viewers

definitions.text: It is just behind the front seats
definitions.meaning: theatre rows are lettered from the stage, so row B is behind row A
the forehead sits over the eyes

explanation.walkthrough: In a theatre the front row is A, so B ROW is just behind it; 'viewers' are eyes, above which is the brow.
explanation.definitionFit: The forehead lies above the eyes, and a theatre's second row is labelled B.

clue.text: The fabric design you are working on now

definitions.meaning: the repeated decorative motif on a cloth
the template a knitter or dressmaker follows

explanation.walkthrough: Two definitions: the decoration printed on cloth, and the paper template being followed by someone sewing or knitting, which the clue says you are using now.
explanation.definitionFit: A decorative motif on cloth and a dressmaker's template both go by this name.

clue.text: Drunk, but held on by a thread

definitions.meaning: slang for intoxicated
fastened with a threaded bolt or fixing

explanation.walkthrough: The second definition reads 'held on by a thread' literally: a screw holds by its spiral thread, not the idiom for precariousness.
explanation.definitionFit: Screwed is slang for inebriated, and a screw fixes things by its spiral groove.

clue.text: The firing of a gun is what reluctant conscripts look forward 'to

definitions.meaning: a gun's shot is its ...
release from military service

explanation.walkthrough: The printed clue ends "forward 'to", the stray apostrophe being a print blemish; the second definition is release from the army.
explanation.definitionFit: Firing a weapon discharges it, and soldiers released from service are given their discharge.

clue.text: West border jam

parts.note: an edge is a border

explanation.surface: A traffic jam on the western boundary.
explanation.definitionFit: To jam something tight is to wedge it, forcing it firmly into place.
